s: In which battle did the Pallava Aparajitavarma defeat the Pandyas?
x:
The Battle of Sripurambiyam (c. 885 CE) was a decisive battle in South Indian history. Aparajitavarman, the Pallava ruler, along with his allies, defeated the Pandya king Varaguna II. Although victorious, the battle significantly weakened Pallava power and paved the way for the rise of the Imperial Cholas under Aditya I, who later defeated Aparajitavarman and annexed the Pallava kingdom.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (1).
